descriptions.notStarted: The strange boy I saw in the middle of the Nihal Desert... apparently, #p2040052# of #b#m222020000##k claimed to know something about him. I better go talk to #b#p2040052##k.
descriptions.inProgress: I told #p2040052# about the boy I saw in Nihal Desert, and he seemed shocked. He said the boy is from a folk tale that ended up here because of the crack in dimension at the Helios Tower. He said #p2101006# gets lonely fast, and he shouldn't be sitting in the desert by himself, so #p2040052# asked me to get back the book #p2101006# from him.
descriptions.completed: I found #p2101006# at Nihal Desert. Looking at a young-looking boy with a sad look in his face, I didn't know what to say... I didn't know what to do to straighten up this mumbled folk tale.
